title: Northwind Robotics raises €40 million Series B led by Halden Ventures
text:
Northwind Robotics, the Rotterdam maker of warehouse picking robots, has raised €40 million in a Series B round led by Halden Ventures, the company said on Wednesday.

Brightwater Capital and existing investor Noordzee Fund also took part. Northwind did not disclose its valuation.

Chief executive Marit de Wolff said the money would pay for a second assembly line in Rotterdam and for the company's first sales and support teams outside Europe. "We have more signed orders than we can build this year," she said.

Northwind leases its robots to warehouse operators and charges per pick. It says more than 400 of its robots are in daily use at customer sites in the Netherlands, Germany and Belgium.
